import django
from django.conf import settings
settings.configure(
    INSTALLED_APPS=["django.contrib.contenttypes", "django.contrib.auth"],
    DATABASES={"default": {"ENGINE": "django.db.backends.sqlite3", "NAME": ":memory:"}},
)
django.setup()
from django.db import models
from django.db.models import signals

received = []
def handler(sender, instance, **kwargs):
    received.append(instance)

class Plain(models.Model):
    image = models.ImageField(upload_to="x")
    class Meta:
        app_label = "auth"

class Dim(models.Model):
    image = models.ImageField(upload_to="x", width_field="w", height_field="h")
    w = models.IntegerField(null=True)
    h = models.IntegerField(null=True)
    class Meta:
        app_label = "auth"

# No dimension fields -> no post_init handler connected
handlers_plain = [r[1]() for r in signals.post_init._live_receivers(Plain)]
print("Plain connected handlers:", [f.__qualname__ for f in handlers_plain])
assert not any("update_dimension_fields" in f.__qualname__ for f in handlers_plain), "handler still connected!"

# With dimension fields -> handler connected and still fires
handlers_dim = [r[1]() for r in signals.post_init._live_receivers(Dim)]
print("Dim connected handlers:", [f.__qualname__ for f in handlers_dim])
assert any("update_dimension_fields" in f.__qualname__ for f in handlers_dim), "handler missing!"

Plain()
Dim()
print("post_init fired during instantiation:", len(received) >= 2, f"({len(received)} times)")
print("OK: handler connected only when width_field/height_field set")
EOF

import django
from django.conf import settings
settings.configure(
    INSTALLED_APPS=["django.contrib.contenttypes", "django.contrib.auth"],
    DATABASES={"default": {"ENGINE": "django.db.backends.sqlite3", "NAME": ":memory:"}},
)
django.setup()
from django.db import models
from django.db.models import signals
from PIL import Image
import io

def count():
    return len(signals.post_init.receivers)

base = count()
class Plain(models.Model):
    image = models.ImageField(upload_to="x")
    class Meta:
        app_label = "auth"
after_plain = count()

class Dim(models.Model):
    image = models.ImageField(upload_to="x", width_field="w", height_field="h")
    w = models.IntegerField(null=True)
    h = models.IntegerField(null=True)
    class Meta:
        app_label = "auth"
after_dim = count()

print(f"receivers: base={base} after Plain={after_plain} after Dim={after_dim}")
assert after_plain == base, "handler connected without dimension fields!"
assert after_dim == base + 1, "handler NOT connected with dimension fields!"

# End-to-end: dimension fields still updated via post_init (bug #11196 case:
# dimension fields declared after the image field)
buf = io.BytesIO()
Image.new("RGB", (4, 8)).save(buf, format="PNG")
buf.seek(0)
p = Dim(name="x", image=buf) if False else Dim(image=buf)
print("Dim instance w/h after init:", p.w, p.h)
assert (p.w, p.h) == (4, 8), "dimension update broken!"
print("OK: handler connected only when width_field/height_field set; dims still update")
EOF
